服务端网关配置说明\n\n一、监听与暴露\n- gateway.port / g:
Server Gateway settings

Listen address and exposure
- gateway.host / gateway.port control the HTTP listen address.
- allow_public_bind defaults to false to prevent exposure without a proxy or tunnel.

Security and skey
- auth_enabled requires Authorization: Bearer <skey> for protected endpoints.
- Enter a name and optional expiration date to generate a skey. The original key is shown only once.
- skeys stores enabled, skey_hash, masked skey, name and expiration. Original keys are never stored.
- Disabled skeys cannot authenticate requests.
- Enable trust_forwarded_headers only behind a trusted reverse proxy.

Rate limits and idempotency
- webhook_rate_limit_per_minute limits webhook requests per minute.
- rate_limit_max_keys limits tracked client keys in memory.
- idempotency_ttl_secs / idempotency_max_keys control webhook idempotency caching.

Node Control
- node_control.enabled enables the experimental node-control API.
- node_control.auth_token is an additional shared token sent as X-Node-Control-Token.
- Empty node_control.allowed_node_ids means no explicit allowlist; * allows all nodes.

Recommended defaults
- Use host 127.0.0.1.
- auth_enabled defaults to false; configure skeys and enable authentication before exposing the service.
- Keep allow_public_bind disabled.
- Trust forwarded headers only in a controlled proxy chain.

技能配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- skills 用于控制技能系统加载来源与系统:
Skill configuration guide

1. Purpose
- skills controls skill discovery sources and system prompt injection.
- The upper configuration section controls loading; the catalog shows skills and their sources through the gateway service.
- These settings affect context length and skill visibility.

2. Page structure
Skills
- Switch between project and all directories. Skills are grouped by project, ancestor, global and built-in sources.
- Select a skill to read SKILL.md, falling back to SKILL.toml.
- Enable, disable or delete local skills. Install built-in skills in an open project.
Plugins
- Manage plugins from the separate Plugins page.
System configuration
- Configure default project skill loading and prompt injection mode here.
- These settings do not remove the built-in skill list.

3. Fields
 auto_load_project_skills
- Boolean (true / false).
- true (default): delegated agents automatically load project and ancestor skills and .agents/skills.
- false: delegated agents load only skills explicitly selected in allowed_skills.
 prompt_injection_mode
- "compact" or "full".
- compact (default): inject metadata and load skill content as needed to save context.
- full: inject complete skill contents for compatibility, using more context.

4. Example
{
  "skills": {
    "auto_load_project_skills": true,
    "prompt_injection_mode": "compact"
  }
}

5. Enabling and disabling
- Local skills use a SKILL.disabled marker in the skill directory.
- Disabled skills stay visible in the catalog but are skipped at runtime, allowing later reactivation.

调度配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- scheduler 用于控制内置调度器的开关:
Scheduler configuration

1. Purpose
scheduler controls the built-in scheduler and its throughput limits, affecting scheduled task polling and concurrent execution.

2. Fields
enabled: enable the scheduler loop.
max_tasks: maximum tasks processed per poll.
max_concurrent: maximum tasks executed concurrently within a poll.

3. Example
{
  "scheduler": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_tasks": 64,
    "max_concurrent": 4
  }
}

4. Recommendations
For long-running tasks, increase max_tasks first and avoid raising max_concurrent too quickly. Reduce max_concurrent when CPU or IO contention occurs.

自治配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- autonomy 控制代理执行权限边界、预算:
Autonomy configuration

1. Purpose
- autonomy controls agent execution permissions, budgets and approval policies.
- It affects shell commands, path access, non-CLI tool exposure and approval workflows.

2. Common fields
1) level
- read_only | supervised | full.
2) workspace_only
- When true, allow only workspace paths except allowed_roots.
3) allowed_commands / forbidden_paths
- Shell command allowlist and path denylist.
4) max_actions_per_hour / max_cost_per_day_cents
- Hourly action and daily cost limits.
5) require_approval_for_medium_risk / block_high_risk_commands
- Require approval for medium risk; block high-risk commands directly when configured.
- The shell quoted-newline restriction defaults to false; enabling it treats newlines inside shell quotes as injection and blocks them.
7) shell_redirect_policy
- block, strip or allow (default: execute unchanged).
8) non_cli_*
- Configure non-CLI tool exposure, approvers and natural-language approval modes.

3. Example
